provenance.title: Brought vs built (say this if a judge asks)
brought: A written spec (CLAUDE.md), the triage procedure and QLD repair rules
Sample data from my course scenario pack: rent roll, maintenance log, tradies, 8 weekend requests
Jane, the Vapi voice agent (voice and prompt set up before)
Accounts and keys: Anthropic, Airtable, Make, Vapi
built: The whole app from an empty folder: portal, triage agent, board, Talk to Jane, Architecture, Guide
The Airtable base, data load and Interface
The Make.com automation, and Jane's link into it
The MCP server for Claude Desktop
provenance.say: I brought a written spec, the sample data and a voice agent I'd already set up. Everything else was built tonight from an empty folder: the app, the triage agent, the Airtable base, the Make automation and the MCP server. Five prompts, two Claude Code tabs.

before: Board open with the 8 weekend requests triaged, plus one Voice card from an earlier call
That call's transcript and summary on screen in a Talk to Jane tab (or a screenshot)
Portal open in another tab, the sink photo ready

steps.say: Harbourline is a seven-person property manager in Brisbane. Maintenance comes in by phone, web form, email and text. Every Monday someone sorts it by hand, and the gas leak gets buried under a dripping tap.

steps.do: Walk the weekend's cards from the top.
steps.say: Here's the weekend, triaged. The two emergencies are at the top. The gas leak: it noticed the after-hours transfer was never answered. It caught a duplicate across two channels, a repeat aircon fault, and it refused to guess which unit 8 a text meant.
Airtable is the source of truth, with a live report on top.

steps.do: Show the earlier call's transcript and summary. No live call.
steps.say: Tenants can also just talk to Jane. A call takes about two minutes, so here's one from earlier.

steps.do: Point to that call's Voice card.
steps.say: Make.com dropped it into the same Airtable base, triaged like everything else.

steps.do: Live: copy the sample address and description, attach the photo, submit.
steps.say: Now a new request, live, with a photo.

steps.do: The new card lands, triaged, with a drafted reply.
steps.say: Nothing is sent. A property manager approves every message.
Built tonight with Opus 5.5 in Claude Code. It runs on Sonnet, so a small agency could afford it every day.

demo.ifTime: If a judge asks how it fits together: open Architecture (system diagram, then the skills map). If time allows: Claude Desktop question 1 or 2. Skip the weekly summary (over a minute).
demo.fallback: If the live submit fails: "Here's one I submitted ten minutes ago" and point to it, or play the backup video.
freeze: One clean voice call (Power points card)
One clean portal request (sample card and sink photo)
Read the Brought vs built card aloud once
